```{r}
build_variance_components <- function(df, station_vars){#, region_time_vars) {

  # WITHIN RT (region-month-year)
  df <- df %>%
    group_by(Region, region_time) %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        all_of(station_vars),
        list(
          rt_mean = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),   # region-time mean (Xbar_rt)
          within_rt = ~ .x - mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE) # dev per station (d_srt)
        ),
        .names = '{.col}_{.fn}'
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  # BETWEEN REGION (regional mean)
  rt_mean_vars <- paste0(station_vars, '_rt_mean')

  region_means <- df %>%
    distinct(
      Region,
      region_time,
      across(all_of(rt_mean_vars))
    ) %>%
    group_by(Region) %>%
    summarize(
      across(
        all_of(rt_mean_vars),
        ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),  # regional mean (Xbar_r)
        .names = '{.col}_bw_region'
      ),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    rename_with(
      ~ sub('_rt_mean_bw_region$', '_bw_region', .x)
    )

  df <- df %>%
    left_join(region_means, by = 'Region')

  # OVER RT (d_rt = Xbar_rt - Xbar_r)
  for (v in station_vars) {
    df[[paste0(v, '_over_rt')]] <-
      df[[paste0(v, '_rt_mean')]] -
      df[[paste0(v, '_bw_region')]]
  }

  # REGION-TIME VARS (already at rt level; no within-rt, has over_rt/bw_region)
  # region_time_bw <- df %>%
  #   distinct(Region, region_time, across(all_of(region_time_vars))) %>%
  #   group_by(Region) %>%
  #   summarize(
  #     across(
  #       all_of(region_time_vars),
  #       ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
  #       .names = '{.col}_bw_region'
  #     ),
  #     .groups = 'drop'
  #   )
  # 
  # df <- df %>%
  #   left_join(region_time_bw, by = 'Region')
  # 
  # for (v in region_time_vars) {
  #   df[[paste0(v, '_over_rt')]] <-
  #     df[[v]] - df[[paste0(v, '_bw_region')]]
  # }

  df
}
```

```{r}
# calc weighted (due to repeated stations) variance
wvar <- function(x, w) {
  keep <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(w)
  x <- x[keep]
  w <- w[keep]
  mu <- weighted.mean(x, w)
  weighted.mean((x - mu)^2, w)
}

calc_variance_decomp <- function(v, df) {
  within_col <- paste0(v, '_within_rt')
  over_col <- paste0(v, '_over_rt')
  bw_col <- paste0(v, '_bw_region')
  
  has_within <- within_col %in% names(df)
  required_cols <- c(v, over_col, bw_col, if (has_within) within_col)
  
  tmp <- df %>%
    filter(if_all(all_of(required_cols), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
    group_by(Region, region_time) %>%
    mutate(wt = 1 / n()) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  total_var <- wvar(tmp[[v]], tmp$wt)
  var_over <- wvar(tmp[[over_col]], tmp$wt)
  var_between <- wvar(tmp[[bw_col]], tmp$wt)
  var_within <- if (has_within) wvar(tmp[[within_col]], tmp$wt) else 0
  
  data.frame(
    variable = v,
    perc_within_rt = if (has_within) (var_within / total_var) * 100 else NA,
    perc_over_rt = (var_over / total_var) * 100,
    perc_bw_region = (var_between / total_var) * 100,
    perc_sum = ((var_within + var_over + var_between) / total_var) * 100
  ) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))
}

```

```{r}
# VARIABLES

station_vars <- c(
  'Temperature',
  'log_DIN',
  'log_DissAmmonia',
  'log_DissNitrateNitrite',
  'log_DIN_lag',
  'log_DissAmmonia_lag',
  'log_DissNitrateNitrite_lag',
  'log_DIN_lag3',
  'log_DissAmmonia_lag3',
  'log_DissNitrateNitrite_lag3',
  'log_DissSilica',
  'log_DissSilica_lag',
  'log_DissSilica_lag3',
  'log_DissOrthophos',
  'log_DissOrthophos_lag',
  'log_DissOrthophos_lag3',
  'log_Turbidity_lag',
  'log_Conductivity'
)

# region_time_vars <- c(
#   'log_graze_rate'
# )

delta_time_vars <- c(
  'log_SAC',
  'log_SJR',
  'log_EXPORTS',
  'log_OUT',
  'log_SAC_lag3',
  'log_SJR_lag3',
  'log_EXPORTS_lag3',
  'log_OUT_lag3'
)

# DATA

# No Bloom: 0; BAB: 1
df_bab <- df_mvi %>%
  filter(mvi_class != 'HAB') %>%
  mutate(
    BAB = as.integer(mvi_class == 'BAB')
  )

df_bab <- build_variance_components(df_bab, station_vars)#, region_time_vars)
```

```{r}
df_subset <- df_bab %>%
  mutate(
    doy = lubridate::yday(Date),
    doy_c = 2 * pi * (doy - 1) / 365.25,
    doy_sin_z = as.numeric(scale(sin(doy_c))),
    doy_cos_z = as.numeric(scale(cos(doy_c)))
  )

m_bab_af <- brm(
  BAB ~ doy_sin_z + doy_cos_z +
    Temperature_over_rt +
    log_Turbidity_lag_within_rt +
    Region * (
      log_SAC + log_SJR + log_EXPORTS +
      log_SAC_lag3 + log_SJR_lag3 + log_EXPORTS_lag3
    ) +
    log_DIN_lag_over_rt +
    log_DIN_lag3_over_rt +
    log_DissSilica_lag_over_rt +
    log_DissSilica_lag3_over_rt +
    log_DissOrthophos_lag_within_rt +
    log_DissOrthophos_lag3_within_rt +
    (1 | Date),
  
  data = df_subset,
  family = bernoulli('logit'),
  
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 1), class = 'b'),
    prior(normal(0, 2.5), class = 'Intercept'),
    prior(exponential(1), class = 'sd')
  ),
  
  chains = 4,
  iter = 1000,
  warmup = 500,
  cores = 4,
  backend = 'rstan',
  seed = 42
)

summary(m_bab_af)
```

```{r}
plot(m_bab_af, ask = FALSE)
```

```{r}
pp_check(m_bab_af, type = 'bars')

pp_check(m_bab_af, type = 'bars_grouped', group = 'Region')
```

```{r}
res <- simulateResiduals(
  fittedModel = m_bab_af,
  n = 250
)

plot(res)
```


```{r}
DHARMa::plotResiduals(res, form = ~ log_SJR_lag3 | Region == 'Central')

DHARMa::plotResiduals(res, form = ~ log_SJR_lag3 | Region == 'Confluence')

DHARMa::plotResiduals(res, form = ~ log_SJR_lag3 | Region == 'Suisun Bay')
```

# Exploratory

```{r}
with(subset(df_mvi, mvi_class == 'BAB'), table(Season, Region))
```

```{r}
df_mvi %>%
  mutate(Month = lubridate::month(Date, label = TRUE)) %>%
  count(Month, mvi_class) %>%
  group_by(Month) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Month, y = prop, fill = mvi_class)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
flow_vars <- c(
  'log_SAC', 'log_SJR', 'log_EXPORTS',
  'log_SAC_lag', 'log_SJR_lag', 'log_EXPORTS_lag',
  'log_SAC_lag3', 'log_SJR_lag3', 'log_EXPORTS_lag3'
)

df_flow_plot <- df_mvi %>%
  group_by(Date, Region) %>%
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    n_HAB = sum(mvi_class == 'No bloom'),
    across(all_of(flow_vars), first),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(flow_vars),
    names_to = 'Variable',
    values_to = 'log_flow'
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Lag = case_when(
      grepl('_lag3$', Variable) ~ '3 months',
      grepl('_lag$', Variable) ~ '1 month',
      TRUE ~ 'Current'
    ),
    Flow = gsub('_lag3$|_lag$', '', gsub('^log_', '', Variable)),
    Lag = factor(Lag, levels = c('Current', '1 month', '3 months'))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(log_flow)) %>%
  group_by(Region, Flow, Lag) %>%
  mutate(Flow_quartile = ntile(log_flow, 4)) %>%
  group_by(Region, Flow, Lag, Flow_quartile) %>%
  summarize(
    n = sum(n),
    n_HAB = sum(n_HAB),
    n_dates = n_distinct(Date),
    HAB_prop = n_HAB / n,
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Lower = qbeta(0.025, n_HAB + 0.5, n - n_HAB + 0.5),
    Upper = qbeta(0.975, n_HAB + 0.5, n - n_HAB + 0.5)
  )

ggplot(
  df_flow_plot,
  aes(x = Flow_quartile, y = HAB_prop, color = Lag, group = Lag)
) +
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 0.7,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.25)
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper),
    width = 0.12,
    alpha = 0.5,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.25)
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 2,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.25)
  ) +
  facet_grid(Region ~ Flow) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:4,
    labels = c('Low', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'High')
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  theme_minimal()
```
